description: All monitored Salesforce orgs at a glance: health score, errors, limits, backups, freshness.

panels.title: Fleet avg health score
panels.description: Average of weekly org health scores. Requires a recent sfdx-hardis version on the monitoring pipeline (empty until then).

targets.expr: (sum(sum_over_time(ApexErrors_metric{source="sfdx-hardis", $env, orgIdentifier=~"$org"}[7d])) or vector(0)) + (sum(sum_over_time(FlowErrors_metric{source="sfdx-hardis", $env, orgIdentifier=~"$org"}[7d])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Silent orgs (36h)

targets.expr: count((sum by (orgIdentifier) (count_over_time({source="sfdx-hardis", $env, orgIdentifier=~"$org"}[7d])) > 0) unless (sum by (orgIdentifier) (count_over_time({source="sfdx-hardis", $env, orgIdentifier=~"$org"}[36h])) > 0))
